items.title: Gunman who killed at least 6 in Kraków mass shooting has died in hospital
items.brief: A gunman who killed at least six people in Kraków, during a deadly rampage in the Polish city’s historic main square on Saturday has died in hospital, Reuters news agency reported on Monday, citing police.
